newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL -- American Power climbing.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL -- American Power climbing.

text.p: American Power Conversion Corp shares were climbing ahead of Friday's market open on buying driven by the company's strong-than-expected third quarter earnings report.
Preceding the market open, American Power shares added two points to 18-1/4, breaking through a year-high 16-3/4.
After Thursday's market close, the company said it earned $0.30 per share, or $27.9 million, in the three months ended September 30 versus $0.18 per share, or $17.1 million in the year-ago.
The Zack's consensus forceast was $0.21 per share.
Gateway 2000 Inc shares retreated to 53-1/4 from 55-1/8 before the open as investors reacted to the company's third quarter earnings news released last night.

The personal computer seller said netted $0.78 per share, $0.05 above the Zack's consensus estimate, versus $0.52 in the year-ago quarter, but also warned of rising selling, general and administrative expenses.
Revenues rose to $1.2 billion from $888.7 million.
Also, Chubb Corp is expected to spike up at the open, following trades to 47-1/4 from 45-1/2 in the pre-open session.
Traders cited a bullish conference call held with analysts yesterday after the company unveiled disappointing quarterly earnings.
Also, Bear Stearns upgraded Chubb to a buy from attrractive, according to a source at the firm.

Also, Reuters Holdings Plc's Nasdaq-listed American Depositary Receipts gained one to 74-1/4 after the company said third quarter revenues rose nine percent to $1.17 billion versus the year-ago period.
Chief Executive Peter Job also said sales of the new 3000 product series introduced in July has met expectectations so far.
